messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
messages.subject: PyStan 2.9.0.0 released
parts:
PyStan 2.9.0.0 is available on PyPI. This release features several minor
bug fixes and introduces support for Windows (Python 3.5 only!)

Changes
-------

- Update Stan source to v2.9.0 (`release notes <https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/releases/tag/v2.9.0>`_)
- Bugs fixed in _chains.pyx and model.py (thanks to @stephen-hoover, Paul Kernfeld)
- Windows wheels (32bit and 64bit, Python 3.5 only)


Download the latest version at

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan
